title: ISNÅLEN LED work lamp
description: ISNÅLEN LED work lamp, white/brass color This work lamp's flexible gooseneck arm and cone-shaped shade give it a bold retro feel. Behind the white surface lies modern technology – a built-in and energy-efficient LED bulb.
features: The light source has a lifetime of approx. 25,000 hours. This corresponds to about 20 years if the lamp is on for 3 hours per day.
The lamp emits 200 lumens, which is approximately equal to the light emitted by a 20-watt incandescent bulb.
The light source is built-in but can be replaced. Available to order as a spare part. For more information, contact customer service at your store or .com.
materialAndCare: Foot: EVA plastic; Weight: Reinforced EVA plastic; Cover/ Shade: Steel, Powder coating; Diffuser: Polycarbonate plastic; Tube: Steel, Brass plated, Clear lacquer
